facts: Fyre Festival takes place across two weekends in 2017: April 28th to April 30th and May 5th to May 7th.
The festival is held on Fyre Cay in the Exumas, approximately a one-hour flight from Miami.
Housing accommodations on the island consist of luxurious tents equipped with charging stations, lights, and beds with linens.
Tickets are non-transferable on third-party websites and resales must be coordinated through Tablelist.
There is a 5-day grace period for monthly billing on payment plans before bookings are cancelled without refunds.
Emergency medical services on the island include a medical tent with professional providers and transport options to facilities in Miami or Nassau.
